question_stem:
A spring balance is used to weigh a cylinder that is immersed in oil, as shown in Fig. 4.1.
The reading on the spring balance is 4.8 N. The length of the cylinder is 5.0 cm and the cross-
sectional area of the cylinder is 13 cm^{2}. The weight of the cylinder is 5.3 N.

acting on the cylinder.
